name: Eutychus
title: The Young Man Raised from the Dead
summary: Eutychus was a young man from Troas who fell out of a third-story window and died while falling asleep during Paul's long sermon. He was miraculously raised from the dead by the apostle Paul, which strengthened the faith of the believers and demonstrated God's power through the apostles.

keyEvents.title: Falls Asleep During Paul's Sermon
keyEvents.description: Eutychus sat in the window frame and was overcome by deep sleep while Paul spoke at length. The room was full of lamps, and it was late at night.

keyEvents.title: Falls from the Third Story
keyEvents.description: In a deep sleep, Eutychus fell out of the window from the third story and was taken up dead. This caused great commotion among the believers who had gathered.

keyEvents.title: Raised by Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul went down, threw himself on him, and embraced him. He declared that life was still in him, and Eutychus came back to life.

keyEvents.title: The Church Comforted
keyEvents.description: Eutychus was taken away alive, and the believers were greatly comforted. This miracle strengthened the church's faith in God's power.
